headline: June inflation drops to 9.16% as food prices moderate
summary: Overall inflation in Bangladesh fell from 9.42% in May, providing some relief to consumers as food price growth slowed.
details: Bangladesh's overall inflation fell to 9.16 percent in June, down from 9.42 percent in May, according to the latest data from the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS).
The decline was primarily driven by a moderation in food prices, which saw inflation drop to 8.60 percent in June from 9.06 percent a month earlier.
Non-food inflation also eased marginally, decreasing from 9.71 percent in May to 9.61 percent in June.
Despite the slight dip, price pressures remain elevated across various other sectors of the economy, keeping the cost of living high for many.
caption:
Inflation in Bangladesh fell to 9.16% in June. Food prices are finally showing some signs of slowing down.

Bangladesh's overall inflation fell to 9.16 percent in June, down from 9.42 percent in May, according to the latest data from the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS).

The decline was primarily driven by a moderation in food prices, which saw inflation drop to 8.60 percent in June from 9.06 percent a month earlier.

Non-food inflation also eased marginally, decreasing from 9.71 percent in May to 9.61 percent in June.

Despite the slight dip, price pressures remain elevated across various other sectors of the economy, keeping the cost of living high for many.

headline_marked: 6 wickets for Nahid: [[Nahid Rana creates history]] as Zimbabwe bowled out for 141
headline: 6 wickets for Nahid: Nahid Rana creates history as Zimbabwe bowled out for 141
summary: Nahid Rana delivers the best bowling figures by any Bangladeshi bowler in ODI history, leading the Tigers to dominate Zimbabwe in Harare.
details: Bangladesh's pace attack dismantled Zimbabwe for 141 runs in 36.4 overs during their encounter in Harare.
Nahid Rana stole the spotlight by claiming 6 wickets for just 21 runs, marking the best bowling performance by any Bangladeshi bowler in One Day Internationals.

This feat surpasses previous records, including the combined 6-wicket hauls of Mashrafe Bin Mortaza and Rubel Hossain, as well as individual efforts by Mustafizur Rahman, Rishad Hossain, and Shoriful Islam.
Zimbabwe, batting first after losing the toss, struggled against the pace of Rana and Taskin Ahmed. Newman Nyamuri top-scored for the visitors with 33 runs.
Supporting the attack, Taskin Ahmed claimed 2 wickets and Mehidy Hasan Miraz took 1 wicket to wrap up the Zimbabwean innings.
caption:
6 wickets for 21 runs! Nahid Rana just scripted history with the best-ever ODI bowling figures for Bangladesh.

Bangladesh's pace attack dismantled Zimbabwe for 141 runs in 36.4 overs during their encounter in Harare.

Nahid Rana stole the spotlight by claiming 6 wickets for just 21 runs, marking the best bowling performance by any Bangladeshi bowler in One Day Internationals.

This feat surpasses previous records, including the combined 6-wicket hauls of Mashrafe Bin Mortaza and Rubel Hossain, as well as individual efforts by Mustafizur Rahman, Rishad Hossain, and Shoriful Islam.

Zimbabwe, batting first after losing the toss, struggled against the pace of Rana and Taskin Ahmed. Newman Nyamuri top-scored for the visitors with 33 runs.

Supporting the attack, Taskin Ahmed claimed 2 wickets and Mehidy Hasan Miraz took 1 wicket to wrap up the Zimbabwean innings.
